title: Alibaba says its 2.4T-parameter Qwen3.8-Max tops Kimi K3 on some benchmarks, and says it plans to release the weights of Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-27B next week (Luz Ding/Bloomberg)
summary: Luz Ding / Bloomberg: Alibaba says its 2.4T-parameter Qwen3.8-Max tops Kimi K3 on some benchmarks, and says it plans to release the weights of Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-27B next week — Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. released its latest flagship AI model, with performance claims putting it alongside global leaders like Anthropic's Fable.
